headline: DET @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 3.85 at CLE 3.54, with a projected total of 7.39. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: DET moved +0.10 runs while CLE moved +0.35, changing the projected margin by -0.25 runs. The projected total climbed +0.45, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jack Flaherty has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for José Ramírez, Kevin McGonigle, Gleyber Torres, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Matt Vierling because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
